tasks.label: Root Standing Reconciliation
tasks.purpose: Reconcile OAN Tech Stack standing, Documentation Repo source-law, admitted write roots, and the local audit state before new work begins.
tasks.completionSignal: The live cycle state records current root availability, admitted write roots, and the lane standing snapshot for the run.
escalatesWhen: root standing cannot be reconciled coherently

tasks.label: Repo Check Cycle
tasks.purpose: Run the posture-aware repo check primitive and record a bounded evidence bundle.
tasks.completionSignal: The latest release-candidate bundle contains repo-check and git-worktree receipts.

tasks.label: Triad Emission
tasks.purpose: Emit the doping header, receipt, and notice that condition the run, record what happened, and signal downstream assumptions.
tasks.completionSignal: The latest release-candidate bundle contains the emitted triad in both JSON and Markdown form.
escalatesWhen: standing cannot be expressed lawfully for the run

tasks.label: Work Reporting
tasks.purpose: Emit the lighter steward work report when the report cadence is due, forced, or the lane posture changes materially.
tasks.completionSignal: The latest work-report bundle contains work-report.json and work-report.md when the report window is due.
escalatesWhen: work report output cannot be written

tasks.label: Digest Surface
tasks.purpose: Emit an operator-readable digest when the digest window is due, forced, or the posture changes materially.
tasks.completionSignal: The latest digest bundle contains release-candidate-digest.json and release-candidate-digest.md.

tasks.label: Promotion Watch
tasks.authority: Automation may classify; HITL decides adoption
tasks.purpose: Track whether the latest local cycle can continue mechanically, now owes HITL review, or is blocked.
tasks.completionSignal: The current cycle posture is reflected in the live tasking status surfaces.

tasks.label: Orchestration Status
tasks.purpose: Record branch, worktree, and later handoff eligibility without turning those signals into v1 blocking conditions.
tasks.completionSignal: The orchestration status surfaces reflect the current branch, worktree state, and advisory publish readiness.
escalatesWhen: branch or worktree visibility cannot be determined
